objective: Forward the strictly non-Season2 per-reaction count wrapping fix to guarded current-main production RC source; do not publish until staging and production AdMob/nav/runtime release gates pass.
productionBaselineEvidence: Exact main baseline aa3aa734b15f6cc2a64fbbbed3dfdd7d4db9539c, stacked atop source-only PR #979 Wall Ad and verified Connect #976 changes. Changed code matches staging for KL and approved #933 source for reaction. No production OTA source marker or backend deployment.
chosenApproach: Add opt-in layout='detail' to the existing reaction component with a 34dp action, a full-width wrapping non-shrinking count summary and numeric chips. Use the backend breakdown sum for the visible detail total when supplied, retaining the backend total fallback. Do not change RPC, data schema, Wall feed, media or ads.
selectionRationale: The individual post was using default single-row nonwrapping action/summary geometry, allowing the numeric reaction chips to be clipped while a redundant total was separated below it; an isolated display layout is the smallest fix.
alternativeApproaches: Change the global default reaction component layout: rejected because that could regress Wall, scope and Connect UI.
Rebuild reaction counts in the database: rejected without evidence of incorrect persisted rows; the screenshot demonstrates a display truncation problem.
preserveBehaviors: The main Wall uses layout='wall' and remains unchanged.
Original post reaction key/RPC, tap, long press and optimistic toggle semantics remain unchanged.
Keep individual post media, photo gallery, privacy, owner/report controls, internal/external share and comment composer.
Keep first-view native AdMob placement and Android runtime unchanged; no OTA without separate staging and production verification.
acceptanceChecks: Every reaction type present has a fully visible, numeric badge; counts wrap on narrow displays without truncation.
Post total displays the sum of the available breakdown, with the backend total when no breakdown exists.
Both changed focused Node tests pass and required Engineering Accountability and Performance/Compact Layout CI pass.
No modification to public Wall feed UI, ad placements or post media lifecycle.
DEV-only PR; do not publish staging or production OTA until release gates.
Preserve current production native SDK, auth, payouts and Season 1 reward policies; no Season2 code/activation or EAS publication by this source commit.
